terra.problem: In “The Philistines find Saul,” the men of Jabesh-gilead retrieved the bodies from Beth-shan, not Mount Gilboa (1 Samuel 31:10–12).
“The Amalekite’s report” is told to David away from Gilboa. The reported events are said to have happened on Gilboa, but the report itself did not.
“David’s song of sorrow” addresses the mountains of Gilboa, but the passage does not place David there when he sings it. “Defiled” may also be difficult for a fifth-grade reader.
